# Nexatools

> Nexatools is a multi-tool SaaS platform with 30+ free online utilities for developers, marketers, and everyday users — PDF editing, image processing, AI writing, and text/data conversion.

Most tools run entirely in your browser (no upload). AI-powered tools require a free account and use a credit system.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Nexatools and featured tools.
- [All tools](/tools): Searchable directory of every tool.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free and Pro plans, credit allowances.
- [About](/about): Who we are and what we build.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about tools, credits, and privacy.
- [Blog](/blog): Tutorials, guides, and product updates.

## Tool categories

- [PDF tools](/categories/pdf): Merge, split, compress, convert, and OCR PDFs.
- [Image tools](/categories/image): Resize, compress, convert, and remove backgrounds.
- [AI tools](/categories/ai): Summarize, translate, rewrite, and chat with documents.
- [Text tools](/categories/text): Word count, case conversion, lorem ipsum, and more.
- [Developer tools](/categories/developer): JSON, Base64, JWT, regex, hashes, and converters.

- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How Nexatools handles your data.
